title: Our Neighbor, the Moon
subtitle: 改寫自 NASA 月球介紹：月球怎麼形成、離我們多遠

source.name: NASA Science
source.title: Moon Facts
source.basis: Work of the U.S. federal government (NASA), 17 U.S.C. §105; retold only from NASA's own text, not from third-party images or material on the page.

sentences.en: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite, and it has been with us for billions of years.
sentences.zh: 月球是地球唯一的天然衛星，它已經陪伴我們數十億年了。

examples.en: The satellite sends pictures back to Earth.
examples.zh: 衛星把照片傳回地球。

examples.en: There are billions of stars in our galaxy.
examples.zh: 我們的銀河系有數十億顆恆星。

grammar.quote: it has been with us for billions of years
grammar.explanation: has been + for + 一段時間，表示從過去一直持續到現在。

examples.en: My family has lived in Taichung for ten years.
examples.zh: 我家已經在台中住了十年。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 it is with us for billions of years，持續到現在要用現在完成式。

sentences.en: Scientists think it formed after a body about the size of Mars crashed into the young Earth.
sentences.zh: 科學家認為，它是在一個大約火星大小的天體撞上年輕的地球之後形成的。

highlights.note: the size of + 名詞，表示「和…一樣大」，前面不用加 as。

examples.en: A car crashed into the tree.
examples.zh: 一輛車撞上了那棵樹。

examples.en: Ice forms when water gets very cold.
examples.zh: 水變得很冷時就會結冰。

connected.note: crashed 的 -ed 讀 /t/，和 into 連在一起。

sentences.en: Pieces from that crash came together and slowly became the Moon we see today.
sentences.zh: 那次撞擊產生的碎片聚集在一起，慢慢變成我們今天看到的月球。

examples.en: The whole town came together to help.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都聚在一起幫忙。

grammar.explanation: the Moon (that) we see today，關係代名詞當受詞時可以省略。

examples.en: This is the book I told you about.
examples.zh: 這就是我跟你說過的那本書。

grammar.pitfall: 當主詞的關係代名詞不能省略：the man who lives here 不能說 the man lives here。

sentences.en: At first, the young Moon was covered by an ocean of hot, melted rock.
sentences.zh: 起初，年輕的月球被一片炙熱熔岩構成的海洋覆蓋。

examples.en: The melted snow turned into a small river.
examples.zh: 融化的雪變成了一條小河。

examples.en: At first, I didn't like the city.
examples.zh: 一開始我並不喜歡這座城市。

grammar.explanation: be covered by/with 表示「被…覆蓋」，是被動語態的常見用法。

examples.en: The mountain was covered with snow.
examples.zh: 山上覆蓋著白雪。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 was cover by，被動要用過去分詞 covered。

sentences.en: Today, it travels around us at an average distance of about three hundred eighty-four thousand kilometers.
sentences.zh: 如今，它繞著我們運行，平均距離大約是 384,000 公里。

highlights.note: 大數字聽力要點：先聽 thousand 前面的部分，384 thousand 就是 384,000。

examples.en: The average temperature here is 25 degrees.
examples.zh: 這裡的平均氣溫是 25 度。

examples.en: The distance between the two cities is 200 kilometers.
examples.zh: 兩座城市之間的距離是 200 公里。

sentences.en: That gap is so wide that about thirty Earth-sized planets could fit in between.
sentences.zh: 這段距離寬到中間大約可以放進 30 顆地球大小的行星。

examples.en: Can all these books fit in your bag?
examples.zh: 這些書全都放得進你的包包嗎？

examples.en: There is a small gap between the two buildings.
examples.zh: 兩棟建築之間有一小段空隙。

grammar.quote: so wide that about thirty Earth-sized planets could fit
grammar.explanation: so + 形容詞 + that 表示結果：寬到可以放進三十顆地球。

examples.en: The room was so small that only two people could sit.
examples.zh: 房間小到只能坐兩個人。

grammar.pitfall: so 後面接形容詞，不要接名詞；名詞要用 such。

sentences.en: The Moon is also moving away from Earth very slowly, by about three point eight centimeters a year.
sentences.zh: 月球也正非常緩慢地遠離地球，每年大約遠離 3.8 公分。

examples.en: Please move away from the edge.
examples.zh: 請離邊緣遠一點。

grammar.quote: by about three point eight centimeters a year
grammar.explanation: 介系詞 by 表示變化的幅度：「每年遠離約 3.8 公分」。

examples.en: Prices went up by ten percent.
examples.zh: 價格上漲了百分之十。

grammar.pitfall: 不要用 with 表示幅度，要用 by。

sentences.en: It is much smaller than our planet, less than a third as wide.
sentences.zh: 它比我們的星球小得多，寬度不到地球的三分之一。

examples.en: A third of the class was absent.
examples.zh: 全班有三分之一的人缺席。

grammar.quote: less than a third as wide
grammar.explanation: 分數 + as + 形容詞，表示倍數比較：寬度只有三分之一，後面省略了 as Earth。

examples.en: My room is half as big as yours.
examples.zh: 我的房間只有你的一半大。

grammar.pitfall: much 用來加強比較級：much smaller，不要說 very smaller。

sentences.en: If Earth were the size of a nickel, the Moon would be about as big as a coffee bean.
sentences.zh: 如果地球只有一枚五分錢硬幣那麼大，月球大概就像一顆咖啡豆那麼大。

examples.en: The candy costs a nickel.
examples.zh: 這顆糖要五分錢。

examples.en: These coffee beans come from Yunlin.
examples.zh: 這些咖啡豆來自雲林。

grammar.quote: If Earth were the size of a nickel, the Moon would be
grammar.explanation: If + 過去式（be 動詞用 were），主要子句用 would，表示和事實相反的假設。

examples.en: If I were a bird, I would fly to you.
examples.zh: 如果我是一隻鳥，我會飛到你身邊。

grammar.pitfall: 假設語氣中 be 動詞所有人稱都可以用 were，正式說法不用 was。

sentences.en: Because the Moon has almost no air, rocks from space hit its surface again and again, leaving craters everywhere.
sentences.zh: 因為月球上幾乎沒有空氣，來自太空的岩石一再撞擊它的表面，到處留下隕石坑。

examples.en: The meteor left a huge crater.
examples.zh: 流星留下一個巨大的坑洞。

examples.en: Leaves floated on the surface of the pond.
examples.zh: 葉子漂浮在池塘水面上。

grammar.explanation: 句尾的 V-ing 分詞片語表示前面動作造成的結果。

examples.en: The storm hit the city, leaving many homes without power.
examples.zh: 暴風雨襲擊城市，造成許多住家停電。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 and leaving，分詞片語前面不加 and。

chunks.text: Because the Moon has almost no air,
chunks.zh: 因為月球幾乎沒有空氣

chunks.text: rocks from space hit its surface again and again,
chunks.zh: 太空岩石一再撞擊它的表面

sentences.en: The dark patches we can see from Earth are called maria, which means "seas" in Latin.
sentences.zh: 我們從地球上看到的那些暗色斑塊叫做「月海」，在拉丁文中是「海」的意思。

examples.en: There was a patch of ice on the road.
examples.zh: 路上有一小塊結冰。

grammar.explanation: 非限定關係子句 , which... 補充說明前面的字 maria 是什麼意思。

examples.en: We had tteokbokki, which is a Korean dish.
examples.zh: 我們吃了辣炒年糕，那是一道韓國菜。

grammar.pitfall: 非限定用法前面要加逗號，而且不能用 that 取代 which。

connected.note: can 在肯定句弱讀成 kən。

sentences.en: They are not really seas, though; they are huge basins that were filled with lava long ago.
sentences.zh: 不過它們並不是真的海，而是很久以前被熔岩填滿的巨大盆地。

highlights.note: 放在句中或句尾的 though 表示「不過」，語氣比 but 柔和。

examples.en: Lava poured out of the volcano.
examples.zh: 熔岩從火山湧出。

examples.en: Taipei sits in a basin.
examples.zh: 台北位在一個盆地裡。

sentences.en: In full sunlight, the surface gets hotter than boiling water, but in the dark it drops to around minus one hundred seventy degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 在陽光直射下，月球表面比沸水還燙，但在黑暗中會降到攝氏零下 170 度左右。

examples.en: Pour boiling water into the cup.
examples.zh: 把滾水倒進杯子裡。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to five degrees last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到五度。

grammar.explanation: get + 比較級表示狀態的變化：變得比…更熱。

examples.en: It gets darker earlier in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天天黑得比較早。

grammar.pitfall: minus 是「零下」，聽到 minus one hundred seventy 不要誤聽成正數。

chunks.text: the surface gets hotter than boiling water,
it drops to around minus one hundred seventy degrees Celsius.
chunks.zh: 降到攝氏零下 170 度左右

sentences.en: The Moon also spins at the same speed as it travels around Earth.
sentences.zh: 月球自轉的速度也和它繞地球公轉的速度相同。

examples.en: The Earth spins once every day.
examples.zh: 地球每天自轉一圈。

grammar.quote: at the same speed as it travels
grammar.explanation: the same + 名詞 + as + 子句，表示「和…一樣的…」。

examples.en: She wore the same dress as I did.
examples.zh: 她穿了和我一樣的洋裝。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 the same speed with，要用 as。

sentences.en: That is why we always see the same side of it from here.
sentences.zh: 這就是為什麼我們在地球上總是看到它的同一面。

examples.en: I missed the bus. That's why I was late.
examples.zh: 我錯過了公車，所以才遲到。

examples.en: Write your name on this side of the paper.
examples.zh: 把名字寫在紙的這一面。
